source_evidence: Player's exact response to general's hypothetical evacuation dilemma is preserved verbatim in pending action. NPCs respond independently: general acknowledges protective purpose, Assembly representative distinguishes temporary evacuation and permanent dispossession, councillor records proposed principles for further consideration without adopting law. Consultation concludes ~15:00. Elara stays briefly to cultivate contacts in her authorized capacity; V's next action remains open. No new contested check, no fabricated policy passage, foreign victims or treaty, no changes to earned rewards or custody. D316~15:00 Caereth palace, defense consultation concludes. V states exact 'Like I said is their mortal dignity at risk? Is being invaded by a foreign nation that forcefully reeducates and experiments on them more dignified than relocation? I think the answer is simple and clear.' General accepts distinction between narrowly necessary protective evacuation and coercion for state control; Assembly representative insists temporary scope, safe shelter and return, councillor records principle for further deliberation, not enacted legislation or compulsory relocation order. No claim of verified experimentation on foreign populations beyond known Kestrel evidence. Existing proposed reciprocal frontier intelligence invitation to Ossent remains in preparation for V's next Orsaven journey, no treaty concluded or sealed diplomatic letter issued yet. Elara willingly remains briefly with councillor's staff to discuss follow-up contacts as standing Vaishnavi representative; V is free to leave or stay, no extra commitment. Companions and four horses/coach at Rethwyn residence, all healthy and custody unchanged. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Fenar59/59 AC14 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6 inactive; Cirren51/51 AC18 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots. Rest0/6 food21/feed28 purse2903gp4sp6cp, conditional240gp loot sale unpaid. Crown frontier intelligence commission active remaining300+1300, written liaison credentials V-held; Kestrel originals retained, Crown copies; Severin assent pending. Defense of Caereth complete and rewards paid. No new money, combat, rolls or rest. Await V next action.
